rows.name: Rosarius of Saint Agatha
rows.text: A standard Rosarius whose field gives +2 to Intimidation Interaction Attacks and blinds and ignites attackers who fail a DN 3 Initiative Test.

rows.name: Skadi Matrix
rows.text: A targeting chip for a Mind Impulse Unit: up to +5 bonus dice on a Ranged Attack at 2 Shock per die, and a +1 DN penalty to enemy attacks.

rows.name: The Cornerstone
rows.text: A brick of Chaos-proof holy power: touching it drops the toucher one Corruption Level, at 1 Mortal Wound per Point removed, once only.

rows.name: The Unwilling Orb
rows.text: A Navigator's third eye in a gem: a Psychic Focus that gives GENESTEALER CULT psykers Tier bonus dice and two free Deny the Witch per round.

rows.name: A Tainted Blade
rows.text: A daemon-bound Chaos power sword (S+8, ED 4, AP -4) that deals 1 Mortal Wound to its user on every rolled Complication.

rows.name: Tome of Loathsome Twisting
rows.text: A daemonology book that, if its gifts are accepted, grants PSYKER, bonus dice and a Chaos familiar at the price of Corruption.
